errors.text: The proposed pressure-temperature window (>20 GPa and 400–600°C) is fundamentally different from the target treatment at 6 GPa and 1473 K for 2 hours.
The proposed FCC-to-HCP transition or stacking-fault mechanism is extrapolated primarily from CoCrFeMnNi and is not established for the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi FCC/B2 alloy.
The hypothesis misses the target structural mechanism: formation of coherent FCC/B2 interfaces and preferential dislocation transfer between the phases.
The stated starting composition/state, AlCoCrFeNi2.1 in an as-cast condition, does not faithfully match homogenized Al0.7CoCrFeNi.
